en.headline: Chan Kin-por appointed Hospital Authority chairman from December
en.dek: The former lawmaker and Executive Council member will succeed Henry Fan for a two-year term starting 1 December, the government said.
body: The government announced on Monday that Chief Executive John Lee has appointed Chan Kin-por as chairman of the Hospital Authority for two years from 1 December 2026, succeeding Henry Fan.
Secretary for Health Lo Chung-mau said Chan’s experience in politics, public service, policy formulation and corporate governance would help lead public healthcare reforms and improve governance.

Chan, a member of the Executive Council and former Legislative Council member for the insurance sector, said he was prepared for the responsibility and would work with the board and management to address challenges including an ageing population.
The Hospital Authority welcomed the appointment. Fan has chaired the body since December 2019.

zh.headline: 陳健波獲委任醫院管理局主席 12月1日起任期兩年
zh.dek: 政府周一宣布，前立法會議員及行政會議成員陳健波將接替范鴻齡，帶領醫管局。
body: 政府周一宣布，行政長官李家超根據《醫院管理局條例》委任陳健波為醫院管理局主席，任期由2026年12月1日起兩年，接替范鴻齡。
醫務衞生局局長盧寵茂表示，陳健波在政治、公共服務、政策制定及企業管治方面經驗豐富，有助帶領公營醫療改革及提升管治水平。
陳健波現為行政會議成員，曾任立法會保險界功能組別議員。他表示已有心理準備承擔重任，將與局方及管理層合作應對人口老化等挑戰。
醫院管理局歡迎是項委任。范鴻齡自2019年12月起擔任主席。
